svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: GKE application platform on Google Cloud
svg.desc: GKE application platform on Google Cloud. 12 components in 8 groups. Connections: Developers to App repository; App repository to Cloud Build (trigger); Cloud Build to Artifact Registry (push image); Cloud Build to Cloud Deploy (create release); Cloud Deploy to GKE cluster shop (roll out); Artifact Registry to GKE cluster shop (pull image); Pods to Memorystore; Pods to Cloud SQL; Pods to Secret Manager; GKE cluster shop to Observability.

text.tspan: GKE application platform on Google Cloud
Cloud Build turns each push into an image in Artifact Registry and a Cloud Deploy release that rolls out to a regional GKE cluster
